description:
Generation contract of EmpathyMap: only what the LLM writes. The system
fields (id, project_id) are added by EmpathyMap, which extends this model.

examples: Wants apps that are easy to use

hears.title: Hears

examples: Overwhelmed by too many app choices
Frustrated with apps that have poor user experience

says_and_does.description: What the persona says and does.

sees.title: Sees

thinks_and_feels.title: Thinks And Feels
